questions.q: Which mode must always be on its own switch on a wing?
questions.explain: Direct servo control is the last resort.

options: P and I on roll and pitch
questions.explain: Autotune doesn't touch P and I — you tune them manually.

questions.q: In which mode does autotune not work?
questions.explain: MANUAL has no stabilization — there's nothing to tune.

questions.q: What is NAV LAUNCH auto launch for?
questions.explain: Throw detection by acceleration, smooth throttle ramp-up.

questions.q: The wing loses altitude while climbing in navigation. What do you check?
questions.explain: nav_fw_cruise_thr and nav_fw_max_thr: low cruise throttle means a stall in the climb.

questions.q: How do you check the elevon reversal before flight?
questions.explain: The surfaces should counteract the tilt; if they help it — reverse in the mixer.

options: A 10° pitch angle in the climb

questions.q: What detects the throw in auto launch?
questions.explain: Then the motor delay and the launch throttle.
